title: Historical similar-case memory
disclosure: Sanitized V1.4.4 DeepSeek online development trace (v141_s06). Scores and outcomes are preserved; full case tables and local paths are not distributed.
query: 寻找与植株 2024-L524 在 2024-11-04 相似且时间上更早的历史案例。

outcome.summary: 返回 5 个时间上更早的跨实体历史案例；相似度约 0.818–0.858，案例 t+7 株高为 210–220 cm。检索置信度为 LOW，不能将相似性解释为因果。

claims.text: Five earlier cross-entity cases were retrieved; their observed t+7 heights range from 210 to 220 cm.
